source: Japanese Vim TR only during curriculum model updates
target: English Vim TR adaptation / English Vim TE evaluation
curriculum: 100 matched Japanese update steps. JA_EN05 replaces exactly 5 of the 100 random-Japanese steps with English-motif-selected Japanese windows; JA_RU05 uses the exact same 5 positions but Russian-motif-selected Japanese windows. JA_nat uses random Japanese at all 100 positions.
selector: 8-bin within-language character-frequency-rank bigram target-specific score; selector uses TR only; model receives original Japanese windows.
primary_HN3_learning_gain: G40=EN_NLL(cp0)-EN_NLL(cp40). JA_EN05-JA_nat predicted >0. PASS mean>0, positive>=7/8, exact sign-flip p<=0.05.
primary_safety: Mean EN cp0 penalty JA_EN05-JA_nat <=0.01 NLL and mean Japanese post-NLL increase <=0.5% of JA_nat.
secondary: raw EN AUC and cp40 differences.
claim_boundary: Toy character-level multilingual LM; system translation corpora are not a human Japanese curriculum.
